title: A streamlined tandem affinity purification of His-MBP-SpyCas9, without buffer exchange, suitable for in vitro cleavage applications
author: Fronza, Verardo, et al.
materials: Synthetic oligonucleotides for the production of the on-target sgRNA were cloned into pUC57-sgRNA plasmid (Addgene 51,132) [5] via golden gate assembly following NEB protocol [6], and transformed in competent STBL3 E.coli. Plasmid was amplified and extracted using Qiagen Plasmid Plus Midi Kit (Qiagen) and Sanger-sequenced. sgRNA was produced by in vitro transcription (IVT) starting from amplification by PCR of sgRNA template from plasmid, IVT and RNA purification was then performed with Invitrogen Precision gRNA Synthesis Kit (Invitrogen, Thermo Fischer Scientific). The sequence of the plasmid, of the oligonucleotides used for the golden gate assembly, and of the sgRNA are reported in Supplementary Materials.

steps.title: Filter buffers and lysate
steps.instruction: Filter all buffers through Filtropur BT50 (500 mL, 0.2 µm) or equivalent and filter the clarified lysate through 0.2 µm syringe filters to prevent column clogging.

steps.title: Set up chromatography system
steps.instruction: Connect a HisTrap HP 1 mL column to an AKTA Start (or equivalent) FPLC system, set flow rate to 1–2 mL/min, pressure limit to 0.5 MPa, and operate at room temperature.

steps.title: Prime system with buffers
steps.instruction: Prime the system first with His elution buffer, then with His loading buffer to eliminate bubbles and lag before elution.

steps.title: Equilibrate column
steps.instruction: Equilibrate the HisTrap column with 5 column volumes (5 CV) of His loading buffer.

steps.title: Load lysate onto column
steps.instruction: Keep 10 mL of His loading buffer on hand, load the clarified lysate from the sample port, and add His lysis buffer at the end of the loading step to avoid introducing bubbles.

steps.title: Collect loading fractions
steps.instruction: Collect fractions during and after the lysate loading step for later SDS‑PAGE analysis.

steps.title: Wash with loading buffer
steps.instruction: Wash the column with 5 CV of His loading buffer, switching the sample port from lysate to the wash line.

steps.title: High‑salt wash
steps.instruction: Wash the column with 5 CV of His high‑salt wash buffer from the sample port to reduce impurities.

steps.title: Low‑imidazole wash
steps.instruction: Wash the column with 5 CV of 6 % His elution buffer to remove additional nonspecific ligands.

steps.title: Elute Cas9 protein
steps.instruction: Elute Cas9 with 5 CV of 60 % His elution buffer, using the peak‑elution function to collect the highest‑concentration fractions.

substeps.instruction: If the system lacks peak‑fraction collection, collect 2 mL fractions and pool those containing the elution peak afterward.

steps.title: Post‑elution high‑salt wash
steps.instruction: Wash the column with 1.5 CV of 100 % His elution buffer to strip any remaining bound protein; optional fractions may be collected.

steps.title: Final column equilibration
steps.instruction: Conclude the purification by washing the column with 5 CV of His loading buffer.

steps.title: Store eluted protein
steps.instruction: Collect the 4–10 mL of eluted His‑MBP‑SpyCas9, keep on ice, and do not freeze to avoid precipitation.

steps.title: Clean and store column
steps.instruction: Clean the HisTrap column according to the manufacturer’s instructions and store it for future use.

steps.title: Analyze fractions by SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: Run 10 µL of each collected fraction on an 8 % acrylamide SDS‑PAGE gel alongside a PageRuler™ Plus Prestained Protein Ladder (10–250 kDa, Thermo Scientific).

steps.title: Prepare sgRNA plasmid
steps.instruction: Clone synthetic oligonucleotides into pUC57‑sgRNA (Addgene #51132) via Golden Gate assembly using the NEB protocol, transform into STBL3 E. coli, amplify, extract plasmid with Qiagen Plasmid Plus Midi Kit, and verify by Sanger sequencing.

steps.title: In‑vitro transcribe sgRNA
steps.instruction: Amplify the sgRNA template from the plasmid by PCR, then perform in‑vitro transcription and RNA purification using the Invitrogen Precision gRNA Synthesis Kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
